A.depoimento:
Our armies moved as one. The knights of Evora charged and broke the archers; at Santarem our archers found their mark.
Both villages now hail King A. Lisboa forges new spears for the coming march.
A.plano:
We attacked both neutrals: Santarem with archers and spears, Evora with knights.
Expect to capture both. Check losses and surviving troops.
Lisboa built 2 spearmen. Next turn: consolidate new villages, build more, explore roads.
Keep some troops at home for defense.

B.depoimento: I trained two spearmen in Barcelona and marched the entire garrison to Tarragona, aiming to seize the neutral village and expand our front.
B.plano: Capture Tarragona this turn. Next turn reinforce Barcelona, then take Girona and push east toward Castellon and Zaragoza. Keep building spearmen for numbers.

A.depoimento: Orders have been given! Our armies are on the march to Coimbra, Badajoz, and Faro simultaneously, while our capital Lisboa works tirelessly to forge new spearmen and send reinforcements to our brave Santarem. We strike fast and hard, aiming to secure the Portuguese coast and push deep into enemy territory before they can react. The crown will not rest until the banners of King A fly over every village!
A.plano: Attacking Coimbra, Badajoz, and Faro this turn to expand our territory to 6 villages. Sent 3 spearmen from Lisboa to Santarem to reinforce it after the attacks. Built 2 spearmen in Lisboa. Next turn: check battle outcomes, consolidate new villages, and start exploring towards Porto, Salamanca, and Sevilha to find the enemy.

B.depoimento:
This turn I ordered two spearmen to be built in Barcelona.
I dispatched two archer squads from Tarragona to take Castellon and two more to take Zaragoza.
The rest of Tarragona's forces marched to Barcelona to reinforce our capital.
B.plano:
Build spearmen in Barcelona to boost numbers.
Use Tarragona's archers to seize Castellon and Zaragoza next turn.
Pull Tarragona's remaining troops to Barcelona for a strong defensive core.
Avoid attacking Girona until we have more forces.

A.depoimento: We have expanded our borders! Our forces have marched on Porto, Sevilha, and reinforced Badajoz. The army is growing, and the enemy's capital will soon be within our reach. Glory to King A!
A.plano: Consolidating new villages and expanding towards Porto, Sevilha, and Salamanca. Sent troops to capture Porto, Sevilha, and reinforce Badajoz for the push to Salamanca. Built spearmans in Lisboa, Santarem, and Evora to grow the army. Next turn: check battle outcomes, capture Salamanca if Badajoz is strong enough, and explore further north/east.

B.depoimento:
I ordered two spearmen to be built in Barcelona and one archer in Tarragona.
I sent a lone knight from Barcelona to capture Girona.
The archers from Castellon and Zaragoza marched to Tarragona to strengthen our forces.
Our army is gathering for a push into the neutral east.
B.plano:
Build spearmen in Barcelona and an archer in Tarragona.
Send a knight from Barcelona to take Girona.
Pull the archers from Castellon and Zaragoza to reinforce Tarragona.
Hold Barcelona and prepare for eastward expansion next turn.

A.depoimento: Ordered the storming of Salamanca with the Badajoz garrison and the assault on Cordoba with our elite knights from Sevilha. Reinforced Badajoz, Coimbra, and Faro with troops from the capital and nearby villages to prepare for the next pushes towards Toledo and Vigo. Focused on building archers to counter the enemy's spearmen.
A.plano: Capture Salamanca and Cordoba this turn. Next turn, send the reinforced Badajoz army to Toledo and the reinforced Coimbra army to Vigo. Focus on building archers to counter enemy spearmans and explore eastwards from Cordoba.

B.depoimento: Built 2 spearmen in Barcelona, 2 archers in Tarragona, and spearmen in Castellon and Zaragoza. Sent reinforcements: 4 spear+1 knight to Zaragoza, 3 spear to Castellon, 2 archers to Valencia, 1 knight to Huesca. Kept garrisons to defend our villages.
B.plano: Hold Barcelona with at least 5 troops, reinforce Castellon and Zaragoza for upcoming pushes. Send archers to Valencia and knight to Huesca to take neutrals next turn. Build spearmen and archers to replenish stocks. Avoid emptying Barcelona or overbuilding knights.

A.depoimento: This turn I focused on preparation. I moved Coimbra's troops to Salamanca and Faro's archer to Sevilha, while building archers in every village. My sights are set on Madrid and Toledo for next turn, which will open the path to the enemy's heartland.
A.plano: Next turn: send Salamanca's army (8 spearman, 3 archer) to Madrid [23]. Send Badajoz's army (2 spearman, 3 archer) to Toledo [11]. Send Sevilha's 2 archers to Cordoba [10] to prepare for Murcia. Keep building archers. Watch for enemy movements.

A.depoimento: With my forces poised at the borders, I launch a coordinated strike against the neutral villages. Badajoz's archers rain down upon Toledo, while my other forces gather strength to claim Vigo, Madrid, and Murcia. The enemy remains unseen, but my watchful eyes will soon reveal their movements.
A.plano: Focus on capturing neutral villages with archers. Badajoz attacks Toledo. Sevilha reinforces Cordoba for Murcia. Coimbra reinforces Porto for Vigo. Santarem and Faro reinforce Badajoz and Sevilha. Wait for Salamanca's reinforcements to attack Madrid next turn. Build archers everywhere.

B.depoimento: This turn I focused on strengthening my armies: trained archers in Tarragona and Valencia, knights in Barcelona, Zaragoza, and Castellon, added an archer in Girona and a spearman in Huesca, preparing for future offensives.
B.plano: Build archers and knights to prepare for capturing neutral villages next turn. Keep resources balanced, avoid exceeding village caps. Do not attack this turn due to insufficient force to win and survive.

A.depoimento: The drums of war beat across the Iberian Peninsula as our archers march on four fronts! We are capturing Vigo, Madrid, Toledo, and Murcia to expand our kingdom's borders. Our forces are coordinated to reinforce each other, ensuring we strike hard and hold fast. The enemy capital remains in the shadows, but our net is tightening!
A.plano: Our archers are attacking Vigo, Madrid, Toledo, and Murcia this turn. Once these neutral villages fall, we must immediately reinforce them to hold against enemy counterattacks. Continue building archers in all villages to maintain our offensive momentum and secure the path to Barcelona.

B.depoimento: Depoimento: This turn I dispatched Castellon's spearmen and knights to take Teruel, and Zaragoza's knights to seize Burgos. I ordered archers in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Valencia and a knight in Huesca to reinforce future offensives. No attacks on Murcia or Pamplona were attempted due to insufficient force.
B.plano: Plano: Secure Teruel and Burgos this turn to expand to 9 villages. Build archers in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Valencia and a knight in Huesca for next turn's push toward Murcia and Pamplona. Avoid attacking Murcia or Pamplona now due to insufficient force. Do not split forces; keep garrisons minimal but sufficient.

A.depoimento: King A's forces launch a multi-pronged offensive this turn! Archers from Toledo march on Teruel, while Vigo's troops strike at Burgos. In the south, Cordoba's knights and archers reinforce the march on Murcia. We must hold the line and push deeper into enemy territory to secure our victory!
A.plano: We are attacking Teruel, Burgos, and Murcia this turn to secure new villages and open the path to the unexplored territories. The 3 archers already marching to Murcia will arrive, followed by our knights and archers to secure it. We must reinforce Toledo with the troops from Salamanca and Badajoz to prepare for an attack on Zaragoza next turn. Continue building archers in all villages to maintain our offensive momentum.

B.depoimento: Today I ordered the construction of archers in our heartland and a knight in Huesca. I sent Huesca's knights to take Pamplona and reinforced Burgos with troops from Zaragoza. Our marching army from Castellon continues toward Teruel.
B.plano: Hold Pamplona and strengthen Burgos; build archers in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Valencia and a knight in Huesca for future offensives. Avoid attacking Murcia or Teruel due to strong enemy armies marching there. Do not split forces unnecessarily; keep garrisons minimal but sufficient.

A.depoimento: This turn, we launched a coordinated offensive on the eastern and northern fronts. Our archers from Teruel marched on Zaragoza, while forces from Vigo and Toledo converged on Burgos. We also sent a small detachment from Murcia to claim the undefended Castellon, securing our path eastward. In the interior, we reinforced our border villages and continued mass-producing archers to fuel our expansion. The enemy will find our net tightening around their remaining strongholds.
A.plano: We are attacking Zaragoza with 6 archers from Teruel, and Burgos with the Vigo archers. We are sending 2 archers from Murcia to capture the empty Castellon. We are reinforcing Badajoz with troops from Santarem and Faro, and Cordoba with troops from Sevilha. Next turn, we must check the outcome of the battles, capture Castellon, Zaragoza, and Burgos, and then push towards Valencia and the unexplored territories (Barcelona, Tarragona). We need to build more archers to maintain our momentum.

B.depoimento: Sent a knight from Pamplona to capture Vigo. Built archers in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Valencia and spearmen in Zaragoza and Burgos. Held our lines against enemy marches. Secured Pamplona with a spearman.
B.plano: Hold Burgos, Valencia, Zaragoza; reinforce them with built spearmen. Send Pamplona's knight to take Vigo. Build archers in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Valencia for future offense. Avoid attacking Toledo, Teruel, Murcia, Madrid due to incoming enemy armies.

A.depoimento: Our armies marched to conquer the empty lands of Castellon and the weak garrison of Huesca, aiming to secure the 18 villages needed for victory. We reinforced our vulnerable border towns of Teruel, Madrid, and Vigo to hold the line against Burgos and Tarragona. Meanwhile, our blacksmiths worked tirelessly, forging 24 new archers to swell our ranks. The path to the capital is long, but the tide of war turns in our favor!
A.plano: We are attacking Castellon with 2 archers from Murcia and Huesca with 3 archers from Zaragoza to reach 18 villages. We reinforce Teruel with 2 spearmans and 1 archer from Toledo, Madrid with 2 archers from Cordoba, and Vigo with 2 archers from Porto. We build 24 archers across our empire. Next turn, check if we conquered Castellon and Huesca, and defend our borders from Tarragona and Burgos.

B.depoimento:
This turn I fortified my borders by sending archers to Tarragona and Valencia, and spearmen to Huesca from Pamplona and Girona.
I dispatched a knight from Burgos to seize the undefended Teruel.
I also ordered spearmen production in every village to strengthen our garrisons for the coming fights.
B.plano:
Hold Burgos, Valencia, Huesca with spearmen reinforcements.
Capture Teruel with a fast knight.
Build spearmen in all villages to boost defense.
Avoid deep attacks into enemy territory until we have more forces.

B.depoimento: I ordered spearmen and archers built across my realms and sent a knightly force from Barcelona to take Zaragoza. I held my borders and readied for the enemy's move on Teruel.
B.plano: Capture Zaragoza with knights from Barcelona. Build spearmen and archers to strengthen defense and prepare future attacks. Avoid deep strikes until we have more forces.

B.depoimento: We sent archers from Valencia to seize Teruel and dispatched knights from Burgos and Zaragoza to take Vigo. Simultaneously, we ordered a wave of archer construction across our realms to bolster our armies. Our forces move swiftly, and the enemy's hold weakens.
B.plano: Capture Teruel and Vigo to expand our front. Build archers in all villages to stockpile for future offensives. Keep knights ready for a strike on Murcia after securing Teruel. Avoid deep strikes into enemy territory until we have superior numbers.

A.depoimento: My armies have taken Teruel and Valencia, expanding our territory. The enemy's assault on Vigo was repelled with heavy reinforcements. We are building archers across the realm to fuel the next wave of conquest. The path to victory is clear.
A.plano: Reinforced Vigo with archers from Salamanca and Porto. Attacked Teruel with 3 archers from Toledo and Valencia with all forces from Murcia. Built archers in all villages. Next turn, use new archers to attack Burgos and Zaragoza. Keep defending Madrid and Toledo.

B.depoimento:
I ordered archers to be built in every village to increase our stockpile.
I sent three archers from Castellon and three from Zaragoza to reinforce Teruel's defense.
I kept Valencia and Teruel's troops in place and maintained the knight march toward Vigo.
B.plano:
Reinforce Teruel with archers from Castellon and Zaragoza to defend against incoming enemy army.
Hold Valencia and keep the knight marching to Vigo for capture next turn.
Build archers in all villages to stockpile; no attacks this turn due to insufficient force.

A.depoimento: King A's forces struck with lightning speed! Madrid's archers crushed Zaragoza, while Vigo and Toledo combined to conquer Burgos. Madrid was reinforced, and we now hold 17 villages. The path to the enemy capital is opening up! Next turn, we will launch the final assault on Castellon to reach 18 villages and secure the crown!
A.plano: Conquered Zaragoza with Madrid's archers, Burgos with Vigo's and Toledo's archers. Reinforced Madrid with Toledo's archers. Sent Murcia's archers to Valencia to prepare for Castellon attack. Next turn, conquer Castellon to reach 18 villages and secure the win condition. Keep building archers and watch for enemy counterattacks on Toledo or Vigo.

B.depoimento: I sent troops to strengthen Zaragoza and Burgos against imminent enemy attacks. I ordered archers to be built in most villages and a spearman in Burgos to recover losses. No attacks were launched this turn, focusing on defense and buildup.
B.plano: Reinforce Zaragoza and Burgos with troops from Tarragona, Huesca, Teruel, and Pamplona. Hold Teruel with remaining archers. Build archers in all villages and a spearman in Burgos to replenish forces. Prepare to defend against incoming enemy armies next turn.

A.depoimento: I have ordered a widespread build of archers to swell my ranks. My armies are moving to reinforce Valencia and Toledo for the coming battles. The attack on Zaragoza should be a straightforward victory, bringing me closer to my goal. I am focused on capturing Castellon and Teruel to secure the win, while remaining vigilant against enemy movements.
A.plano: This turn, I am building archers in all villages to strengthen my forces. I am sending all archers from Murcia to Valencia to prepare for the attack on Castellon. I am sending 6 archers from Badajoz to Toledo to prepare for the attack on Teruel. I am attacking Zaragoza with 4 archers from Madrid to conquer it quickly. Next turn, I will send from Valencia to Castellon, from Toledo to Teruel, and reinforce Madrid or Zaragoza as needed. I must watch for enemy counterattacks and ensure I hold new conquests for at least two turns.

B.depoimento: Depoimento: This turn we slipped a lone archer into Murcia to claim it empty, funneled fresh archers and spears into Burgos and Zaragoza to meet the enemy’s marches, and flooded every village with new archers. Our walls grow stronger while the foe’s advance meets rising steel.
B.plano: Plano: Capture Murcia to gain a village, reinforce Burgos and Zaragoza with archers and spears, and max out archer production in all towns. Hold interior forces ready to counter any enemy thrust toward Toledo or Valencia. Avoid costly knights and premature deep strikes.

A.depoimento: I have strengthened Murcia's defenses and launched a decisive blow against Castellon. My armies are growing as I build across all lands. The enemy is on the move, but I will not yield an inch.
A.plano: Reinforced Murcia with 10 archers from Cordoba to hold the enemy attack. Attacked Castellon with 12 archers from Valencia to capture it. Built troops in all villages, including knights for future counter attacks. Next turn I will reinforce Castellon and prepare to attack Teruel, while watching for enemy counterattacks on Toledo and Madrid.

B.depoimento: Ordered mass archer production across the realm. Launched a strong archer strike from Burgos to seize Madrid, aiming to expand our hold.
B.plano: Capture Madrid with archers from Burgos. Build archers and spearmen in key villages to reinforce; avoid Murcia due to unknown enemy reinforcements.

A.depoimento: My lords, this turn we mobilize our full might to break the enemy's defenses! We are sending our elite archers and knights from Castellon, Toledo, and Murcia to strike Tarragona, Madrid, and Teruel simultaneously. Our blacksmiths are working overtime, forging archers in every single village to swell our ranks. If these assaults succeed, we will claim 18 villages, reaching the 75% threshold required for victory! May our swords be swift and our aim true!
A.plano: We are launching a coordinated three-pronged assault to conquer Tarragona [13], Madrid [23], and Teruel [20] this turn. By sending all available troops from Castellon, Toledo, and Murcia, we aim to overwhelm their garrisons and secure 18 villages (75% of the map) to trigger the victory condition. We must hold these newly conquered villages for two consecutive turns. Meanwhile, we are building archers in all 15 of our villages to ensure our army grows continuously and we can defend our borders.

B.depoimento: I sent archers to bolster Tarragona, Madrid, and Teruel, launched attacks on Toledo, Castellon, Murcia, and Cordoba, and ordered production of archers and spearmen across my realms.
B.plano: Reinforce Tarragona, Madrid, Teruel with archers; attack weak enemy villages Toledo, Castellon, Murcia, Cordoba; build archers and spearmen for future. Keep enough defenders at each village; avoid costly knights and risky deep raids.

A.depoimento: Today, we mobilized our entire northern and central forces for a decisive push on Burgos. Vigo, Madrid, and Toledo answered the call, sending their finest archers and spearmans to crush the enemy garrison and secure the road to the north. In the south, we sent reinforcements toward Tarragona to prepare for its capture next turn. Our blacksmiths worked tirelessly across the realm, forging new archers to replenish our ranks and ensure our dominance on the battlefield.
A.plano: We are launching a massive assault on Burgos [22] this turn, sending all available troops from Vigo, Madrid, and Toledo to conquer it and reinforce the garrison. We also sent Valencia's troops to Tarragona [13] to arrive next turn. We are building archers in all 16 villages to replenish our forces. Next turn, we must conquer one more village (likely Tarragona or Zaragoza) to reach 18 villages and secure the victory condition. We must ensure our newly conquered villages are defended.

A.depoimento: This turn was about steeling our empire for the decisive push. We built archers across our lands and knights in Tarragona, readying the hammer blow for next turn. We sent reinforcements from Salamanca, Castellon, Cordoba, and Madrid to guard our borders. All our hope rests on the brave soldiers marching on Burgos, who must conquer it tomorrow to grant us the victory we have fought so hard for!
A.plano: Our marching armies from Vigo and Madrid are arriving at Burgos [22] next turn to conquer it and reach 18 villages. We must defend Burgos immediately upon conquest and watch for enemy counterattacks from Zaragoza. We built knights in Tarragona [13] to launch a stronger assault on Zaragoza next turn; do NOT attack Zaragoza this turn as our current force would tie and lose. We reinforced Toledo, Vigo, Tarragona, and Murcia to secure our borders.

B.depoimento: Built knights in all villages. Sent forces to capture Madrid, Murcia, Vigo, and retake Tarragona. Reinforced Barcelona and Burgos. Defended Zaragoza.
B.plano: Hold Barcelona and Zaragoza, reinforce Burgos, take Madrid, Murcia, Vigo, retake Tarragona. Keep at least 7 troops in Barcelona for defense. Do not attack Toledo or Castellon now.

A.depoimento: I ordered the assault on Pamplona from Burgos, sending a mixed force of spearmans and archers to exploit the counter triangle against their knights. At the same time, I rushed reinforcements to Murcia to repel the enemy's invasion, and strengthened Salamanca's garrison. My villages are building archers and knights to sustain the campaign. The path to victory is within reach.
A.plano: Attack Pamplona [21] from Burgos [22] with 3 spearmans + 3 archers to reach 18 villages. Reinforce Murcia [19] from Valencia [16] and Cordoba [10] against enemy attack. Reinforce Salamanca [8] from Coimbra [3]. Build archers everywhere, knights in Tarragona [13] and Burgos [22]. Watch for enemy counterattacks on Pamplona from Huesca [18] and on Burgos from Zaragoza [17]. Do NOT attack Zaragoza or Barcelona this turn.

B.depoimento:
I sent three archers from Madrid to take Cordoba.
I reinforced Pamplona with two knights from Huesca and built archers and spearmen across my realms.
B.plano:
Capture Cordoba to gain an eighth village.
Keep Barcelona and Zaragoza defended; watch enemy marches.
Do not attack Toledo, Tarragona, Burgos, or Murcia now.

A.depoimento: This turn we launched a massive multi-pronged offensive, attacking Cordoba, Teruel, and Madrid simultaneously to overwhelm the enemy's defenses. We sent 10 archers from Sevilha to Cordoba, 8 from Toledo to Teruel, and 6 from Salamanca to Madrid. We also sent 4 archers from Burgos to reinforce Pamplona. We built archers across our empire to prepare for the next turn. We expect to conquer three new villages and secure our borders!
A.plano: Conquered Cordoba, Teruel, Madrid. Reinforced Pamplona with 4 archers from Burgos. If Pamplona fell, retake it next turn. If not, build more there. Build archers everywhere to replenish. Watch for enemy counterattacks on Toledo and Burgos from Zaragoza, and Tarragona from Barcelona.

B.depoimento: We sent Zaragoza's infantry to Teruel and Madrid, Huesca supplied archers for both reinforcement and the Pamplona assault, Teruel's knights took Toledo, and Madrid sent an archer to Cordoba. Our core villages stand ready.
B.plano: Reinforce Teruel and Madrid with Zaragoza's troops, send archers to bolster Cordoba, attack Pamplona with Huesca archers and Toledo with Teruel knights, keep Barcelona and Girona as reserves, prepare for enemy marches.

A.depoimento: We have reinforced our borders and sent a strong force from Cordoba to retake Madrid. Tarragona and Pamplona have been reinforced to hold against any enemy counterattacks. Our archers are being built in every village to ensure our army remains unstoppable.
A.plano: Reinforced Tarragona and Pamplona. Sent 6 archers from Cordoba to conquer Madrid. Built archers in all villages to replenish ranks. Watch Tarragona defense against Barcelona; if Barcelona attacks, we should win. Next turn, check if Madrid was conquered and if we hold 18+ villages for the win.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered spearmen production in all my villages to increase manpower. I sent three archers from Zaragoza and three spearmen from Teruel to Madrid to strengthen its defense against the enemy armies arriving next turn.
B.plano: Reinforce Madrid with Zaragoza archers and Teruel spearmen; build spearmen everywhere to stockpile; avoid offensive moves this turn due to weak forces; prepare for future attacks after buildup.

A.depoimento: The enemy army is marching on Madrid, our weakest city. I have sent a large force of archers to reinforce it and ordered all villages to build more troops. We must hold Madrid to keep our 19 villages and move toward victory.
A.plano: Reinforcing Madrid with 19 archers from Cordoba, Salamanca, Toledo, Burgos. Building 2 archers in all villages. Next turn, check Madrid defense and village count (18+). Watch enemy moves on Toledo, Burgos, Castellon.

B.depoimento:
This turn I ordered the construction of one knight in each of our five villages.
We stockpiled heavy cavalry for future offensives while holding our current positions.
No attacks were launched due to insufficient force.
B.plano:
Build knights in all villages to prepare for attacks on Toledo and Burgos next turn.
Keep defenses strong and avoid offensive moves this turn.
Wait for reinforcements before striking.
